text_block_list.name: Helios & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Lost agaaaaiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah!
My runaway lead didn't work this time either~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I really thought we had it in this mock race...
Even after all that special training!!
choice_data_list: You both got pretty close, though
You both were so close, though

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We lost the exact same way last time!
Could it be that our current running styles just aren't suited to us...?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! Need some advice, please!
I hate not being able to have fun running~!!
choice_data_list: Hmm... maybe you both need a change of pace first.

text_block_list.text:
Right on! SO! YO!
Niece AND niece's MATE!!

SAD is BAD! Let's go SABA SABA cool!
YOU KNOW! Speaking truth like an absolute pro!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yacchan?!
Yacchan!! For real, the real deal?!

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text:
Real as real gets! This blazing rap soul is all the proof you need☆
HEY YO! Believe it! My dear niece!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
'Course I believe it! No one else got
such insanely sharp rap skills like my auntie~~~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Helios's aunt...
You mean the world-famous rapper?!

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text:
YES☆ And you're Bamboo Memory, right?
Thanks for taking care of my Helios~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you! The pleasure is mine!
Wait, what brings someone so famous to the Academy?

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text:
Well, my world tour just wrapped up,
so I came to see my cute niece!
Was planning to swing by my parents' place after, but――

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text:
Forget that!
Let's all go on a trip right now, HOOOOOO☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?!
Wait, hold on! Please wait up~~~!!

――And before we knew it, we had boarded a train
and arrived at a tourist hotspot.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Crazy! Massive deer encounter!
They're totally gunning for these crackers, aren't they?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you blending in a bit too fast?! Well,
now that we're here, might as well enjoy it to the fullest!
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, where's Yacchan-san?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She's over there rapping to the deer non-stop!
Even though they keep completely ignoring her, she's so persistent!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotta mad respect Yacchan
for never breaking her mental☆

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text: Gotta make it ROCK ROCK! Spin that potter's wheel ROCK!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! This whoosh-whoosh feel,
it's kinda like scratching records, maybe?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose either!
Uwooooh!! Burn, hot-blooded pottery spinning!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Yacchan-san's piece
is super crooked?! Is that okay?!

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, Bam-chan, this is the right way!
A masterpiece infused with an ONLY ONE soul☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, totally fits!
Yacchan's personality is turned up to max☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Personality...

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text:
For the LAST, what else? I'm a RAPPER!
Raise the TENSION at the LIVE, going UPPER!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wrapping up with a live show, as expected of a pro rapper!
Getting to hear professional rap live is so inspiring!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
They look this way, but walk right past!
Big big sadness, bummer vibes~.

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text:
Who cares, PEOPLE! Gonna sing, YEEHAW!
Never give up, and it'll reach their HEART!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still... that's amazing.
No matter the adversity, Yacchan-san never gives up on her path!

A high-energy rap live performance started out of nowhere.
At first, everyone watched from a distance, but――

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
YAAAAY!
Yacchan is the BEEEEST!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yacchan, insane~?!
She just kept singing and a whole huge crowd gathered!!

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you two! That is the ANSWER!
Just keep moving forward being who you are--!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's just as Yacchan-san says.
Even if it doesn't work right now, if I keep running true to myself, a path will surely open...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally☆
Mad respect for Yacchan!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Today's live was crazy hype too,
gotta polish my skills in both racing and DJing!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yup!
'Cause I'm aimin' to be the DJ version of Yacchan!

I remembered how she earnestly faced the turntable
and brilliantly hyped up the crowd before.

Her roots as a DJ came from her aunt――
Thinking about it that way made total sense.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Plus, when I DJ for Yacchan's live shows,
I can't look lame up there!
choice_data_list: I'll be cheering for your racing and DJing both

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hehe!
Big mega thanks, super hype☆
